contentMix.ownersOnly: Only company owners can change the content mix.

analytics.title: Post analytics
analytics.description: Read engagement metrics for posts published through Buffer. This uses a Buffer Personal API Key, which is separate from the Buffer connection used for publishing.
analytics.connectBufferFirst: Connect Buffer before adding an analytics key.
analytics.keyHelp: Generate a key at publish.buffer.com/settings/api. It is encrypted before storage and never shown again.
analytics.ownersOnly: Only company owners can manage the analytics key.
analytics.ownersOnlyStatus: Only company owners can see whether the analytics key is set up.
analytics.bufferLagNote: Buffer updates metrics once a day
analytics.pendingOnCard: Waiting for the first metrics sync.
analytics.noDataOnCard: Buffer has not reported any metrics for this post.
analytics.forbiddenOnCard: This API key does not have access to the Buffer account this post was published from. Please use a Personal API Key from that same Buffer account.
analytics.autoRefreshNote: Statistics refresh automatically once a day, least recently checked first. With many published posts, a full round can take longer than a day.
analytics.syncNoPosts: No published posts to sync yet.
analytics.syncNoDataYet: Checked {examined} posts — Buffer has no metrics for them yet. It updates once a day, so they will appear at one of the next automatic refreshes.
analytics.syncAllForbidden: This API key does not have access to the Buffer account these posts were published from. Please use a Personal API Key from that same Buffer account.

syncSkipped.INVALID_KEY: Buffer rejected the key. It may have been revoked — add it again.
syncSkipped.INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE: This key cannot read analytics. Check that it is a Personal API Key.
syncSkipped.RATE_LIMITED: Buffer is rate limiting requests. The next automatic refresh will try again.

analytics.syncFailedAfterSave: The key was saved, but metrics could not be synced yet. The next automatic refresh will try again.

noChannels.title: No channels connected yet
noChannels.description: Connect Buffer and enable a channel in Brand Setup to start planning posts here.

posts.emptyDesc: Posts generated for this channel show up here.
posts.noMatchesDesc: Select All posts to see the rest.

calendar.emptyDesc: Posts appear on the day they are scheduled for, or the day they went out.

kpi.awaitingMetrics: {count, plural, one {# post is still waiting for its first sync} other {# posts are still waiting for their first sync}}
kpi.allChannelsNote: Across all channels only reactions, comments and shares are shown. Reach, impressions, clicks and engagement rate are measured differently on each network, so a combined total would not mean anything. Pick a channel to see them.

chart.title: Performance over time
chart.description: Daily engagement of the posts published in this period.
chart.note: Buffer reports lifetime totals, so daily figures are the difference between two readings. Days with no reading are left blank rather than shown as zero.
chart.emptyDescription: A daily figure needs a post to be read twice. Statistics refresh once a day, so the chart fills in over the coming days.

topPosts.title: Top posts
topPosts.description: The posts that drew the most engagement in this period.
topPosts.rankedBy: Ranked by reactions, comments and shares combined — the only figures that mean the same thing on every network. Posts without statistics yet are not listed.
topPosts.emptyDescription: None of the posts in this period have been read by the daily sync yet. They will appear once they have.

sources.title: Performance by source
sources.description: How the content of each source performs, on average per post.
sources.averageNote: Averages count only the posts that actually reported the metric — a post the network did not measure is left out of the calculation rather than counted as zero.

notConfigured.title: Analytics are not set up
notConfigured.ownerDescription: Add a Buffer Personal API Key to read engagement statistics for the posts you publish.
notConfigured.editorDescription: This company has no analytics key yet. An owner can add one from the Buffer settings.

noPosts.title: Nothing published in this period
noPosts.description: Choose a longer period, or another channel, to see statistics.

generationTrace.title: Generation Summary
generationTrace.subtitle: Every step from the request to the saved post.
generationTrace.error: The generation trace could not be loaded.
generationTrace.empty: No trace was recorded for this post.
generationTrace.emptyHint: Tracing records a run as it happens, so posts generated before it was switched on have none.
generationTrace.truncatedWarning: Some values were shortened to fit. Anything cut off is marked in place.

linked.label: Full detail
linked.available: Prompts and raw reply are in the linked run below.
linked.missing: The linked run is no longer available.
linked.heading: Linked run

generationTrace.rawHint: The complete trace as stored, including every field the timeline summarises.
